neighbours.label: The token ' T' as the first piece of a capitalised word the tokenizer splits (T|aurus, T|ropic, T|undra), vs T-words that are one token
fire: Every spring the herd crosses the Tundra in search of fresh grass.
For the party he rented a black Tuxedo with a silver tie.
Our grandmother never cooked eggs in anything but an old Teflon pan.
The pudding was thickened with Tapioca and served cold.
Next week the planet Venus enters Taurus for about a month.
A rolling Tumbleweed crossed the road in front of our car.
The ship crossed the Tropic just after sunrise on the third day.
My favourite stir fry uses crispy Tofu and plenty of garlic.
quiet: Every spring the herd crosses the Texas plains in search of fresh grass.
For the party he rented a black jacket with a silver tie.
Our grandmother never cooked eggs in anything but an old iron pan.
The pudding was thickened with flour and served cold.
Next week the planet Venus enters Leo for about a month.
A rolling ball of dry weeds crossed the road in front of our car.
The ship crossed the line just after sunrise on the third day.
My favourite stir fry uses crispy Tomato slices and plenty of garlic.
